title: UpdateMetricRequest
description: PATCH /api/metrics/:id body — absent-vs-null convention mirroring MetricPanelConfig.Patch. A field absent from the body leaves the current value unchanged. `description` and `format` are independently nullable: explicit `null` clears the field, an object replaces it whole (the whole `format` object is replaced or cleared on PATCH — no deep merge of its individual sub-fields like `unit`/`decimals`). `name`/`measureField`/`aggregation`/`allowedDimensions`/`deprecated` are replace-when-present only (not independently nullable — an empty `allowedDimensions` is itself a valid present value, not "clear"). `dataTypeId` is not patchable. The merged result is re-validated against the same rules as create.
